data.name: Shanhe Builders
data.detailed_description:
Shanhe Builders is a 3D top-down home-building survival simulation set in a fictional world inspired by ancient China. Lead one to three settlers into a plain, offshore island, great-river valley, or wetland. Begin with gathering, hauling, and a temporary shelter, then turn a patch of wilderness into a place where people can live.

Choose where to make a home

Four landscape types and three map sizes create different shorelines, vegetation, and resource layouts. Versioned recipes and seeds make the same starting conditions reproducible, helping you understand why a settlement succeeds or stalls.

Turn plans into real work

Designate resource sources and storage, then place blueprints for rammed-earth walls, fences, regional homes, beds, campfires, and wells. Settlers reserve items, haul materials, clear and level ground, deliver supplies, and construct in stages. Set work priorities from above or take direct control of one resident.

Care for a small group

Hunger, energy, body temperature, health, and injury create needs for food, rest, washing, and first aid. Day and night, seasons, temperature, and deterministic weather shape the environment around the settlement.

A focused playable foundation

The current formal build follows a clear first-settlement arc: complete a rammed-earth wall, bring in the first food harvest, cook rice porridge in a clay pot, and make sure a resident actually eats it. An optional step-by-step guide and explicit success or failure outcome make the production chain readable.

Development is ongoing. The current version does not yet include saving, combat, animals, manufacturing, research, or a long-form campaign, and the store materials do not present those systems as finished gameplay.

data.short_description: Lead one to three settlers in a deterministic 3D home-building survival simulation. Choose a landscape, gather and haul resources, build shelter and walls, grow rice, cook a first meal, and keep the group alive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
